# InfieldButton { #anylumino.InfieldButton }

```python
InfieldButton(
    label='',
    *,
    component_kind='infield-button',
    icon='',
    disabled=False,
    callbacks=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Button designed for placement inside an input field.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type     | Description                                                           | Default            |
|----------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| label          | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.        | `''`               |
| component_kind | optional | Internal component kind used by specialized button subclasses.        | `'infield-button'` |
| icon           | optional | Spectrum workflow icon name.                                          | `''`               |
| disabled       | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                 | `False`            |
| callbacks      | optional | Optional callbacks invoked when the widget sends an activation event. | `None`             |
